The '''Clacis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DFS" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Garret Callron]].<ref name="AIR" /> The sector was later a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] at the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

Planets in Clacis included [[Ord Sedra]], which was attacked by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. A combined Imperial-[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] force [[Battle of Ord Sedra|liberated]] the captives on the planet.<ref name="EO" />
